title: Predicting Field Experiments with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Labeling field experiment conclusions for gender relevance and gender favorability (pro-female/anti-male vs. pro-male/anti-female) using an LLM, then applying OLS regression to analyze how these factors impact the model's prediction accuracy.

Prompting an LLM to label the ethnicity relevance and sentiment of field experiment conclusions, and using OLS regression to test the interaction effect of the ethnicity topic and sentiment on the model's prediction accuracy.

Prompting an LLM to label the age relevance and sentiment of field experiment conclusions, and using OLS regression to test the interaction effect of the age topic and sentiment on the model's prediction accuracy.

Prompting an LLM to label the socioeconomic status relevance and sentiment of field experiment conclusions, and using OLS regression to test the interaction effect of the socioeconomic topic and sentiment on the model's prediction accuracy.
